title: HostConfig
description: Destination side: the standalone hands host's explicit configuration.

bindings.description: Owner-installed workspace bindings, keyed by binding id.

listen.description: Socket address to listen on: a tailnet or loopback address, never a wildcard.

origin.description: Canonical root HTTPS origin printed in pairing QRs.

state_dir.description: Private host state (pairing store, claim journal); absolute.

max_concurrent_calls.description: Destination ceiling for concurrent leases per paired device.

max_lease_ms.description: Destination ceiling for the lease an origin may request.

root.description: Native workspace root; the hands' only writable tree.

bpf.description: Linux: compiled seccomp filter. Must be absent on macOS.

daemon.description: The pi-env daemon run inside the hands.

protected_roots.description: Roots the hands may never see (credentials, runtime, authority).

shim.description: Linux: Landlock shim binary. Must be absent on macOS.
